newsitem.title: USA: BEFORE THE BELL - DIGITAL BID HIGHER.
newsitem.headline: BEFORE THE BELL - DIGITAL BID HIGHER.

text.p: Shares in Digital Equipment Corp were bid higher in dealings ahead of the opening on Wall Street on Monday following a report it was seeking to sell its computer-networking equipment business, traders said.
Traders said DEC was bid at 44-1/8, although the shares had not traded. The stock closed Friday at 43-12/16.
The Wall Street Journal reported that DEC, which declined comment, is seeking to sell the unit in the face of stiffer competition. It said the unit could bring $500 to $750 milion.
Traders said pre-opening dealings were otherwise quite ahead of the market opening with few special situations.
